events_milestones.details: Four cornerstones: Kuehne+Nagel Experience, Digital Ecosystem, Living ESG, Market Potential. Goal of becoming most trusted supply chain partner supporting sustainable future.
First logistics company ever to join Switzerland's blue-chip stock market index
Leading freight forwarder specialised in air transport and handling perishable goods. Handled 40,000+ tonnes air freight and 20,000+ TEU sea freight in 2022. 450 employees. 140+ million CHF turnover.

events_milestones.description: Put option exercise by Apex management
events_milestones.details: Apex management exercised put options to sell 3.9% of retained shares. Settlement with treasury shares fair value CHF 323 million. Group ownership increased to 71.2%.

events_milestones.description: Agreement to acquire Farrow Group Inc.
events_milestones.target: Farrow Group Inc., Canada-based customs broker
events_milestones.details: 100% acquisition for CHF 166 million purchase price. 830 employees in 41 locations across Canada and USA. 112-year heritage. Managed 1.5+ million customs entries in 2022. Closed January 31, 2024.
Succeeded Lothar Harings (long-standing CHRO). Previously Chief Human Resources Officer at Migros, Switzerland's largest private employer with 100,000+ workforce.

events_milestones.description: Michael Aldwell appointed Executive Vice President Sea Logistics
events_milestones.details: Succeeded Otto Schacht after 26 years at Kuehne+Nagel. Aldwell brings 16+ years experience in Sea Logistics. New Zealander with broad operational experience.

events_milestones.description: Dr. Marc Pfeffer appointed Chief Legal Officer
events_milestones.details: Executive Vice President Legal and Governance. Previously Group General Counsel since 2014 and Corporate Secretary since 2019.
Material impact on Q1 2026 earnings. Costs per unit sustainably reduced through efficiency measures.

events_milestones.description: Put last two Boeing 747s into service
events_milestones.details: Last two Boeing 747s ever to be produced now in operation transporting high-quality goods from machinery to automotive components and pharmaceuticals globally under Kuehne+Nagel flag.
